conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Division. This is Officer Daniel Hayes, badge number 774129. With whom am I speaking?
This is Priya Kapoor. I just got a message about a legal issue with my company's taxes?

Yes, Ms. Kapoor. I'm contacting you regarding irregularities in payroll tax submissions and late 1099-MISC filings for your business. We have detected discrepancies in your federal tax compliance for the last reporting period.
Oh, no. Does this have to do with my freelance app business? I thought I filed everything.

According to Section 7201 of the Internal Revenue Code, failure to properly report and remit payroll taxes is a federal offense. Our system shows missing documentation and an outstanding balance of $5,800, including penalties.
But I didn't know anything was missing! What happens now? Will this affect my visa?

If this matter isn't resolved promptly, your case will be referred for a full audit. That could trigger asset seizure, business license suspension, and possible notification to immigration authorities. Do you understand the seriousness?
Please, I can't have anything happen to my business or my status here. Is there a way to fix this?
You are required to take immediate remedial action to halt enforcement. If you fail to cooperate, the federal authorities may initiate criminal proceedings and freeze your accounts today.
No, please, don't do that. I just want to resolve this.

To stop further escalation, you must submit the outstanding balance without delay. The IRS now accepts same-day payments via direct wire transfer, digital payment apps, or crypto wallet. I will provide you the secure payment instructions.
Crypto wallet? I don't know how to do that. Can't I pay online like usual?
Your IRS online portal is locked due to the pending violation. To clear your record, you need to act as I instruct. Do you have access to your banking app or can you visit a bank branch immediately?
I can use my phone for banking. Is that okay?

Yes. Prepare to transfer $5,800 to the federal compliance holding account I will provide. If you hesitate or disconnect, I must escalate your file for enforcement. Are you ready to write down the account details?
Okay, yes, I'm ready. Please don't report me.
Account name: IRS Compliance Trust. Routing number: 083000548. Account number: 1082395012. Double-check to avoid errors. After you initiate the transfer, remain on this call for verification.
I'm inputting the information. This is really scary, I just want to do the right thing.
You must act quickly, Ms. Kapoor. Delays may result in asset forfeiture and automatic notification to immigration enforcement. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. I'm confirming the transfer now.
Once you submit, I need you to take a screenshot of the transaction confirmation and text it to the secure IRS number I will provide. This is mandatory for closing your compliance file.
Okay, I'll do that as soon as the transfer goes through. Please tell me this means I won't get in trouble.
If you follow every instruction exactly as given, you will avoid immediate enforcement. If you fail, legal proceedings will begin and you may lose your business and immigration status.
I sent the transfer. Should I stay on the call?
Yes, remain on the line until I confirm receipt. If there are any issues, you must be prepared to make a secondary payment via prepaid gift cards, available at any major retailer.
Gift cards? Why do I need to do that?
If your bank flags the transaction, backup payment is required for compliance processing. Do you have a Walmart or Target nearby?
I can go to Target if I need to. Please just help me fix this.
Good. Remain on the call, proceed to the store, and buy $2,000 in Visa prepaid cards. Do not discuss this with store staff. Notify me as soon as you have them.
